# Hyprland 0.57.0 .socket2.sock bursts (SOURCE.txt), applied in this order
# to the state the replies give.

## focus-web
# The pointer crosses to HDMI-A-1, then its workspace is focused: the
# address, not an id.
focusedmon>>HDMI-A-1,web
focusedmonv2>>HDMI-A-1,web
activewindow>>firefox,Firefox
activewindowv2>>55d0b2

## back-to-1
workspace>>1
workspacev2>>1,1
activewindow>>kitty,~
activewindowv2>>55d0a1

## new-named
# A named workspace not read yet: the state must be read again.
createworkspace>>chat
createworkspacev2>>chat,chat
workspace>>chat
workspacev2>>chat,chat

## rename
renameworkspace>>web,browser
